xsheet.note: the geese rest on the marsh with wings folded low
the first group on the left opens its wings and lifts off
the main group lifts off; groups on either side follow one after another through frame 10
the flock climbs past the bare trees, wings beating out of step
the flock spreads across the upper half of the sky up to the top edge, drifting right
the flock flies on to the right over the next stand of trees

camera_source: Lucas-Kanade on corner features outside the dilated SAM mask (trees, reeds, water), median step per frame; frames with no usable features take the neighbours' step; a 3-frame mean removes the long-short step alternation of the footage; scaled by 1.62/2 so that the tree plane (z 1.62 from depth) slides by the measured amount. shots/animal-migration-sam/camera.json was not used because it holds still from frame 19 to 42 while the footage pans.
